'''Tree Kachirho''' was one of the inhabited [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] that made up the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] settlement of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The home [[Tree/Legends|tree]] of [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]], it hosted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] command post during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="CL" />
